lines.text: David prays for God to hear him because the voice of the enemy has made his heart pound with fear.
David wishes for wings like a dove so he could fly to the temple and find rest.
David asks the Lord to confuse their speech because he sees violence and strife in the city, where malice and deceit fill the streets.
The one who turned against David is not an enemy but his brother, with whom he walked into the house of God.
David calls to God morning, noon, and night, and says to cast your burden upon the LORD, who sustains the righteous.
